messages:
sofia: quick heads up - bringing up cerulean-13b-64k (int4v2) on staging. perf looks fine but we observed deterministic context corruption when prefill crosses 65536 tokens. reproduces 3/3.
ram: can you paste the serve args + quant flags? which rope variant?
sofia: serve args below. quant: int4v2, global_scale_clip=0.98, pad=vector. rope: scaled with posscale clamp enabled. runtime: `--max-context 131072 --prefill 66000 --kv_cache true --rope_scheme scaled`.
sofia: (serve snippet)
```bash
./serve --model cerulean-13b-64k-int4v2 \
  --port 9000 --max-tokens 140000 --kv_cache true --rope_scheme scaled --quant int4v2
```
maya: interesting, 65536 boundary. our sharding split is 4x16k on staging (four shards each 16384). are you seeing a wrap at 65535 -> 0 in the kv indices?
sofia: yes. KV_DEBUG dump: `pos=65535 shard_offset=1 window=65536 kv_slot=65535 -> next pos=65536 computed kv_slot=0` but the expected slot is 65536 (which should map to global slot 65536, not zero) - looks like an unsigned/signed truncation when serializing global_pos to the shard (we're losing the high bit).
ram: which serialization path? the handshake path for quant kernels was recently modified to pack offsets into a 16-bit field for network savings. maybe we overflow there. check `handshake_encode_offsets()` in shards/pack.c.
sofia: digging: encode uses `uint16_t` for delta_pos when `compact_offsets=true`. For values >65535 it wraps. our prefill used absolute pos 66000 -> delta 66000 -> 4464 (wrap).
maya: that explains it. why didn't we hit this earlier? probably because earlier prefill rarely exceeded 64k and compact_offsets defaulted to false. new int4v2 runtime enabled compact_offsets=true.
bench-bot: canary run started for cerulean-13b-64k-int4v2 at sha ab12cd3 0/30 tests passing so far.
ram: immediate mitigation: turn off compact_offsets when prefill > 60000. We should also make encode function use variable-length encoding (VLQ) or at least uint32 for global_pos.
sofia: quick patch applied locally (force compact_offsets=false). retest: continuity restored to 99.8%. perf hit ~1.3% on p99 but acceptable as a temporary workaround.
maya: long-term fix: change handshake format to use u32 for offsets and add compatibility flag. also add unit tests for offsets at 0..2^20 range.
ram: also add assertion in quantized kernels: if (pos > UINT16_MAX) warn and fallback to un-compacted path. avoid silent corruption.
sofia: adding eval notes: embedding cosine drift prefill <=64k was 0.03, after wrap jumps to 0.24. baseline continuity metric (repeat phrase) drops from 99.9 -> 62.1. attached repro client below.
sofia: repro client
```python
from client import Client
c = Client('http://staging:9000')
prompt = 'x'*66000 + '\n
continue:'
resp = c.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=32)
print(resp.text[:200])
```
maya: filed bug ML-6799 with KV_DEBUG dumps and handshake traces. assigning to eng-ml-ops.
bench-bot: queued long-regression (100k token prefill) 00m ETA.
ram: next steps: (1) PR handshake u32 switch + compat flag, (2) add offset fuzz unit test that simulates compacted path, (3) add regression to nightly longprefill canary.
sofia: I'll open the PR and include failing log, reproducer, and perf numbers for compact_offsets=false. anyone want to review?
maya: happy to. also let's add a small telemetry metric to track any handshake compacted flag usage and count wrap incidents.
ram: good call. add a check in telemetry to emit `kv_handshake_wraps` if we ever see delta_pos != actual_delta.
sofia: thanks folks. will post PR link and bench-bot outputs here when available. :rocket:
